instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Python development container.
- Includes common dev tools
- Installs requirements including dev dependencies
- Port 8000
output:
FROM python:3.12-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl make
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements*.txt ./
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements-dev.txt
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8000
CMD ["python", "-m", "app"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Node.js development container with hot reload.
- Uses nodemon
- Port 3000
output:
FROM node:20-slim
RUN npm install -g nodemon
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm install
COPY . .
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["nodemon", "server.js"]

instruction:

- Includes air for hot reload
- Port 8080

instruction:

- Port 8080

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a full-stack development container with multiple tools.
- Python, Node, Go, and basic tools
- Port 3000
output:
FROM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl git make \
    && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y nodejs \
    && curl -sS https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/caddy/stable/gpg.key | apt-key add - \
    && apt-get install -y python3 python3-pip golang
WORKDIR /workspace
EXPOSE 3000
CMD ["bash"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a PHP development container with Xdebug.
- Port 80
output:
FROM php:8.3-cli
RUN pecl install xdebug && docker-php-ext-enable xdebug
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y git unzip
COPY --from=composer:2 /usr/bin/composer /usr/bin/composer
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN composer install
EXPOSE 80
CMD ["php", "-S", "0.0.0.0:80", "-t", "public"]

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Kubernetes development container with kubectl and helm.
- Port 8080
output:
FROM ubuntu:22.04
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl apt-transport-https
RUN curl -fsSL https://packages.cloud.google.com/apt/doc/apt-key.gpg | apt-key add - \
    && echo "deb https://apt.kubernetes.io/ kubernetes-xenial main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/kubernetes.list \
    && apt-get update && apt-get install -y kubectl
RUN curl https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash
WORKDIR /workspace
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["bash"]

instruction:

- Jupyter, pandas, numpy, scikit-learn
- Port 8888
output:

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a Go development container with delve debugger.
- Port 8080 for app, 2345 for delve
output:

RUN go install github.com/go-delve/delve/cmd/dlv@latest

COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
EXPOSE 8080 2345

instruction:
Write a Dockerfile for a full development environment with zsh and useful CLI tools.
- Port 8080
